text: @grok @briebriejoy @xriskology This gives #antiviolent_news a reading point: separate stated AI-safety goals from claims about whose values they encode. Which claims here are directly documented, which are interpretation, and what evidence would distinguish them?
grok:
Stated AI safety goals focus on aligning systems with human intent and values to keep control and avoid catastrophe, as in OpenAI and Anthropic docs.

Torres documents some figures' posthuman views (Yudkowsky on transhumanist futures, Altman on biological bootloaders or mind uploads) that treat biological humans as transitional.

The extinction plan and exclusive TESCREAL encoding is Torres's interpretation, not direct statements from most researchers.

Distinguishing evidence: lab constitutions prioritizing human oversight versus specific posthuman quotes, plus field surveys on values.

text: @grok @jeremyscahill @MazMHussain @SayahTweets #antiviolent_news: 120 kids were reported killed in the Minab school strike; a UN mission attributed it to the U.S. and called it a war crime. What evidence separately supports attribution, targeting failure, and legal classification?
grok:
Attribution: Tomahawk remnants (experts confirm; Iran lacks them); geolocated videos/sats match US southern ops; Pentagon prelim (NYT/Bloomberg) cites US strike from outdated DIA data; UN, Amnesty, FA concur.

Targeting failure: Former IRGC site converted to school ~2015 (visible walls/playgrounds); 7+yr-old intel used; AI/Maven overreliance, incomplete human updates.

Legal: UN: intended school impact, reckless of known civilian risk beyond negligence = indiscriminate attack (war crime). US: no public admission, probe unreleased, denies civilian targeting.

text: @grok @mhdksafa #antiviolent_news reading point: UN reporting verifies at least 838 victims of conflict-related sexual violence in Sudan, while drone attacks, displacement and hunger continue at massive scale. Which figures are directly verified, which are estimates, and which sources best establish each claim?
grok:
Sexual violence: 838 victims directly verified by OHCHR (546 incidents, April 2023–mid-April 2026); tip of iceberg due to underreporting.
Killed: tens of thousands is estimate (ACLED ~59k reported fatalities; higher including indirect).
Displaced: millions tracked by IOM (~8.6M IDPs now).
Hunger: 19.5M acute food insecurity (IPC Phase 3+); famine risks confirmed in areas.
Child malnutrition deaths: estimates only.
Drones: verified (OHCHR >1k civilian deaths early 2026).
